title: Kruskal Algorithm
definition: A Greedy algorithm that finds the Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) for a connected weighted graph. It sorts all edges and uses Union-Find (DSU) to avoid cycles. O(E log E).
simpleExplanation: Trying to connect 5 cities with internet cables using the absolute cheapest amount of cable possible.

answers.question: **Basic:** Describe the fundamental approach for Kruskal.
**Intermediate 1:** Add Memoization (Top-Down) to Kruskal to prevent redundant calculations.
**Intermediate 2:** Convert Kruskal into a Tabulation (Bottom-Up) approach.
**Advanced:** Solve a 2D matrix or multi-state problem using Kruskal.
**Expert/FAANG:** Optimize the space complexity of Kruskal from O(N) to O(1) or O(N^2) to O(N).
